text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
BULKERS.
Calliope - (built 1983) 18,764 dwt sold to Hong Kong buyer for $7.2 million.
Hudson Bay - (built 1981) 54,309 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $5.75 million.
Tanglaw - (built 1978) 51,658 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $5.2 million.
Soya Queen - (built 1975) 50,826 dwt sold for $4.2 million.
Promina - (built 1990) 48,320 dwt sold to New York Greek buyers for $18 million.
Lucky Grace - (built 1995) 27,837 dwt sold for $17.1 million.
Ruder Boskovic - (built 1974) 27,020 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $1.6 million.
Kai Manu - (built 1984) 13,568 dwt sold to Hong Kong based buyers for $4.5 million.
TANKERS.
Freja Svea - (built 1989) 97,197 dwt sold for $30 million.
Canadian Liberty - (built 1980) 87,542 dwt sold for $12.5 million.
World Castle - (built 1982) 48,532 dwt sold for $16 million.
RO-RO VESSELS.
Proso - (built 1978) 26,802 dwt sold for $4.1 million.
REEFER.
Asuka Reefer - (built 1983) 6,410 dwt sold to Chilean buyers for $6.5 million.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION.
BULKERS.
Nessie - (built 1972) 110,343 dwt sold to India for $135 plt.
Forest Way - (built 1977) 43,250 dwt sold to Bangladesh buyers for $179 plt.
